# Task (image generation only — do not edit any other files)

Use your image generation tool. Attach BOTH reference images to every generation: `ref_front.png` (3/4 front view, the creature faces to the right) and `ref_back.png` (back view). Save the results exactly as:

1. `out/keys_2x2.png` — prompt A below
2. `out/sw_single.png` — prompt B below

Do not write or modify any other file. When both PNGs are saved, reply with their paths and the image sizes.

## Prompt A (2x2 key views)

Create a high-resolution 2x2 grid (1376x768) of authentic 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art monster sprites on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF). Turn the creature from the two attached reference images (pixel sprites: front view and back view) into crisp, larger pixel-art sprites, keeping its exact design, proportions and colours.

CRITICAL ANATOMICAL & DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS (MUST FOLLOW 100%):
1. Body: a single hard insect cocoon / chrysalis shell shaped like a curved crescent or a bent pointed bean. A pointed tip at the top, a wide middle, and the bottom curls forward into a short blunt segmented tail tip that rests on the ground. The whole creature is ONE rigid shell piece.
2. NO LIMBS (No-Limb Rule, most important): zero legs, zero arms, zero hands, zero feet, zero wings, zero antennae, zero horns, no mouth opening. Do not add any limb or appendage. The shell simply stands on its curved bottom.
3. Colour palette:
   - Shell plates: bright leaf green (#83C54A) with pale lime highlights (#B4E652) on the upper plates.
   - Front belly area (the concave inner side of the crescent): dull sage green (#6A8B5A) with darker green shading (#4A6A52).
   - Plate seams: thin dark green lines (#394A41) dividing the shell into angular armour plates (about 6 to 8 plates on the outer side) and 3 to 4 horizontal ring segments at the curled bottom tip.
   - Outlines: crisp 1-2px black / very dark green pixel-art outline, no anti-aliasing halo.
4. Eye (1-Eye-per-side Rule): exactly one narrow, half-closed, sleepy eye on each side of the head part of the shell: a small white slit (#FFFFFF) with a dark heavy upper lid line, set under the pointed top, on the inner (front) side. In a side view only ONE eye is visible. In back views no eye is visible.
5. Do not add extra parts, spikes, leaves or patterns. Do not change the number of anything.

GRID LAYOUT (4 key poses, large and crisp, same size, bottoms on the same baseline):
- Top-Left: SOUTH (0°, front view) — the shell faces straight toward the viewer, nearly symmetric: the sage-green front belly area in the middle, a sleepy eye on the left and on the right just under the pointed top, the curled segmented bottom tip curling toward the viewer at the bottom.
- Top-Right: EAST (90°, right side profile) — exactly like the front reference: crescent bent toward the right, pointed tip at the top, one sleepy eye on the right inner side, the sage belly area on the right, the segmented bottom tip curling toward the right, plated green back on the left.
- Bottom-Left: NORTH-EAST (135°, back-right 3/4 view) — seen from behind and to the right: we mostly see the plated green back of the shell and its pointed top, the face turned away to the upper right, no eye visible, the segmented bottom tip pokes out at the lower right.
- Bottom-Right: NORTH (180°, pure back view) — seen straight from behind, symmetric: the plated green back of the shell, pointed tip on top, no eye, the curled bottom tip hidden behind or just peeking under the body.

## Prompt B (south-west single)

Create a single ultra-crisp 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art sprite (1376x768) on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF) of the same creature, matching the attached front reference image exactly in design and colours: a single rigid green crescent-shaped cocoon shell (bright leaf green #83C54A plates with lime highlights, thin dark green seams, dull sage-green belly area on the inner curve), a pointed top, a sleepy narrow white eye with a heavy dark lid, and a short segmented bottom tip that curls forward and rests on the ground. NO legs, NO arms, NO wings, NO antennae, no mouth.
View: SOUTH-WEST 3/4 quarter view, halfway between facing the viewer and facing left: the crescent bends toward the lower-left, the sage belly area faces diagonally down-left, both sleepy eyes visible in natural 3/4 perspective (the far one smaller), the segmented bottom tip curls toward the lower-left. Crisp 1-2px dark outline, limited palette, no anti-aliasing.
